- Miss red flags in actual relationships

- Interpret coincidences as destiny in ways that don't serve us

- Working through why relationships haven't worked (patterns, boundaries, self-esteem?)
- Addressing the friendship distance directly if possible
- Therapy or counseling to rebuild stability
